## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 2b20287b1767d5736128f8

ac2749328b2458ef63

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `Z3UnsafeFormulaManager.java` (the file fixed in `a7f8831`)
with `git log --follow -p`, looking for when the `isAtom`/`getArity`/`getArg` logic was introduced or last semantically changed. I also inspected the test added just
before the fix (`3661e14`), which shows the bug was known and gated with `assume(...).isNotEqualTo(
Solvers.Z3)` for Z3 specifically, and checked whether a Z3 native-library version bump around that time (`3f1586e` → re

verted by `69062da`) could explain it.

**(2) The bug:** In `isAtom(Long t)`, the `switch (astKind)` only has a
`case Z3_APP_AST:`; every other AST kind (including `Z3_QUANTIFIER_AST`) falls into `default: return true;`, inc
orrectly classifying quantified formulas (`forall`/`exists`) as atoms. Similarly, `getArity(Long t)` and `getArg(Long t, int n)` unconditionally call `get_app_num_args`/`get_app_arg`, which are only
valid for `Z3_APP_AST` nodes, without checking the AST kind — so calling them on a quantifier node is undefined/incorrect behavior instead of fail
ing loudly. The fix adds an explicit `case Z3_QUANTIFIER_AST: return false;` in `isAtom` and `Preconditions.checkArgument(get_ast_kind(...

) == Z3_APP_AST)` guards in `getArity`/`getArg`.

**(3) Evidence:** Diffing the file between the repository's root commit (`2b20287`, "
Big scary changelist for moving the solver-specific files into a separate changelist" — confirmed via `git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD` to be the literal first commit of this
repo) and the commit immediately preceding the fix (`a7f8831^`) shows the `isAtom`/`getArity`/`getArg` bodies are byte-for-byte identical in logic; every intervening commit (`3e4655d`, `b
0bddeb`, `1456646`, `0dead58`, `05afb71`, `319e9c3`, etc.) only did renaming, reformatting, or
import reorganization — none touched this logic. The `Z3_QUANTIFIER_AST` constant was already imported and used elsewhere (e.g., `isQuantification`) throughout this

history, yet it was never wired into `isAtom`/`getArity`/`getArg`, meaning the omission was present from the very first commit that introduced the file, not from a later regression. I also verified this
wasn't caused by the temporary Z3 native-library bump (`3f1586e` → reverted `69062da`): that bump was reverted back to the original version
(`z3-4.4.1-87-gad58226`) hours before the fix commit, and the Java-level code never changed to acc

ommodate or depend on that bump.

I'm confident the defective code has been in the repository unchanged since its root commit — there is no separate "
introducing" commit within this repo's history distinct from that initial import, so `2b20287` is the earliest point at which the bug can be attributed in
this repository's Git history.
